name: io.github.alekskram/hyperliquid-agent-gateway
title: Hyperliquid Agent Gateway
description: Read-only MCP gateway to Hyperliquid: 233 perps + spot, funding carry screener, account liquidation risk, trader activity, HyperEVM transfers. No keys.

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description: Perp snapshot from one call: mark, OI, volume, premium, leverage

tools.name: funding_carry_screener
tools.description: Ranks all perps by funding carry, history only for the top-N

tools.name: liquidation_risk
tools.description: Per-account margin summary, leverage and liquidation distance

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Book-derived bid/ask/mid that never leaves [bid, ask], labeled fallbacks

tools.name: trader_activity
tools.description: Any address: fills PnL, fees, volume, win-rate, open positions
